title: Admin privileges are dangerous
summary: ## Severity  **Likelihood:** Low, because it requires a malicious/compromised admin  **Impact:** High, because a rug pull can be executed  ## Description  A malicious or a compromised admin can execute a 100% rug pull in the following way:  1. The `LP` admin calls the `Factory` contract to add a malicious `core` to the `LP` 2. The malicious `core` returns the `LP` contract balance when its `resolveAffiliateReward` method is called 3. Now calling `claimAffiliateReward` with the fake `core` as an argument will result in a 100% of the `LP` balance stolen  Same thing applies to `withdrawPayout`.
